correctness.rationale: For n>=3, overlap de Bruijn graph has edge set U_n and strongly connected vertices of admissible (n-1)-words. Supply-imbalance sources have differing first pair/equal final pair; any balancing path from s to sink must traverse at least d(s), first later equal-pair index. Appending opposite bits for exactly d(s) steps reaches a sink, and the last equal-pair position in the endpoint recovers s uniquely; this bijects all sources and sinks. An Euler circuit of the augmented graph gives an admissible cyclic cover with exactly sum d(s)=2F_(n-1)-2 extra edges; Fibonacci recurrence yields M_n. n=2 handled separately by 0011. Independent independent-overlap graph BFS plus exact assignment calculation for n=3..10 gave M_n=6,12,20,34,56,92,150,244 and matching extra counts, without using finite testing as the all-n proof.
